title: Drunken Sailor
credit: John Chambers ABC collection, 2011; traditional sea-shanty melody and chord symbols
adaptations: First eight verse bars, in the source D Dorian mode. All melody pitches, rhythms and chord symbols retained; no lyrics imported. Classroom tempo selected at 112 crotchets per minute.

title: Minuet in G
credit: Lester Bailey ABC collection, mirrored by John Chambers; melody by Christian Petzold (BWV Anh. 114)
adaptations: First eight bars of the original G-major melody, with pitches and durations unchanged. New simple classroom chord accompaniment; not a transcription of the original keyboard bass. Classroom tempo selected at 108 crotchets per minute.

title: Skye Boat Song
credit: Terry Traub ABC collection, mirrored by John Chambers; traditional Scottish melody
adaptations: First eight written bars, taking the first ending. Original G-major melody and chord symbols retained; the optional D7 alternative in bar 1 is represented by G. The D across bars 7–8 remains one six-beat tied note. Classroom tempo selected at 96 crotchets per minute.

title: Jingle Bells
credit: John Chambers ABC collection; melody by James Lord Pierpont, 1857
adaptations: Eight chorus bars through the first ending. Source 2/4 is written in 4/4 by doubling every note duration, and the melody is lowered one octave. Chord symbols are retained, including C7 and the D7–G7 ending. No lyrics imported.

title: Au clair de la lune
credit: Edinburgh Repository of Music, volume 2, page 78; transcribed by John Chambers in 2015
adaptations: The source's four-bar first strain is played twice, as indicated by its repeat signs. Transposed from G to C and lowered into the classroom octave; source 2/4 note durations doubled for 4/4. The printed eighth-note ornament in bars 3/7 and rests in bars 4/8 are retained. New simple classroom chord accompaniment.
